premise: Deer is so tall and so careful of his hooves that he cannot bend down to smell Flower; Butterfly and Bee carry her scent up to him on their wings.
inspiration: The Fox and the Grapes (Aesop), turned: instead of deciding the flower is not worth it, the tall one is helped by the small ones, and the flower is glad to be shared.
lesson: What you cannot reach alone, friends can bring you.

en-US.title: Deer and the Far-Away Flower
en-US.text: {butterfly:float loop 0.5} {bee:float loop 0.5} Deer was the tallest animal in the forest. His legs were long. His neck was long. His head was so far up it was nearly in the clouds. Down in the grass lived Flower, small and pink and sweet-smelling. Every morning Deer walked past and thought, I would love to smell that flower. But his hooves were big and Flower was small, and Deer was careful. {deer:pulse} He sighed. Butterfly saw. Bee saw. Butterfly {butterfly:float 0.8} landed on Flower and brushed their wings on her petals. Bee {bee:hop x2} rolled in her middle until she was dusty gold. Then up, up, up they {butterfly:hop} {bee:hop} flew, right to Deer's nose. Deer sniffed. {deer:sparkle} Oh! He smelled honey and sunshine and pink. Thank you, said Deer, and he closed his eyes. Down in the grass, Flower {flower:pulse} {flower:hearts} stood a little taller. She had been up to the clouds today.

es-ES.title: Ciervo y la flor lejana
es-ES.text: {butterfly:float loop 0.5} {bee:float loop 0.5} Ciervo era el animal más alto del bosque. Sus patas eran largas. Su cuello era largo. Su cabeza estaba tan arriba que casi tocaba las nubes. Abajo, entre la hierba, vivía Flor, pequeña, rosa y muy perfumada. Cada mañana Ciervo pasaba por allí y pensaba: me encantaría oler esa flor. Pero sus pezuñas eran grandes y Flor era pequeña, y Ciervo era cuidadoso. {deer:pulse} Suspiró. Mariposa lo vio. Abeja lo vio. Mariposa {butterfly:float 0.8} se posó en Flor y rozó sus pétalos con las alas. Abeja {bee:hop x2} se revolcó en su centro hasta quedar dorada de polvo. Y arriba, arriba, arriba {butterfly:hop} {bee:hop} volaron, hasta la nariz de Ciervo. Ciervo olió. {deer:sparkle} ¡Oh! Olía a miel, a sol y a rosa. Gracias, dijo Ciervo, y cerró los ojos. Abajo, entre la hierba, Flor {flower:pulse} {flower:hearts} se puso un poquito más alta. Hoy había subido hasta las nubes.
